Eg.bar_b_note: Both skins are noisy blotch camouflage (black/orange on A, lime/black on B) with no face read and a body barely taller than the trainer, well short of the board's clean, colour-blocked creatures.

Ln.bar_b_note: The fur base is naturalistic and on-scale, but the yellow-black blotchy back plates and dark face lose the head at small size.

Zi.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing elder with readable eyes and an earthy green/olive palette that matches the key art's settlement folk; the face is a touch softer and more toy-like than the naturalistic creature bar.

Cb.bar_b_note: A low-slung salamander that never stands taller than the trainer; B's cyan body with violet fin separates from the ground, while A's glossy near-black purple turns to a dark smear.

Uv.bar_b_note: The fleece, horns and blue accents hold the owner's Stormcapra bar; B sinks on faint mid/end, where the body flips upside down and floats above its shadow.

Rp.bar_b_note: A clean blue/white spotted water drake with good length over the trainer, held back by a thin build, a small head and (B) red crest tips; A's ridden frame shows no visible rider.

Zk.bar_b_note: B's large, wrapped recipe text on a blue-grey panel fits the UI direction, but the murky, flat, rainy night world behind it has none of Valheim's light or Palworld's colour.

Vv.bar_b_note: A naturalistic dark wolf with real fur mass and a clear silhouette over the trainer, on par with Tanglevolt; its dark brown-black values sit close to the stage, with no rim light to lift them.

Hd.bar_b_note: A adds a timber frame, cross-brace, cap and stone footing, but the infill is still a flat pale card; B is a blown-out white sheet in a thin frame; both stand alone on low-detail grass with a flat sky.

Nj.bar_b_note: This is the same blue drake as Rp; B's pale peach crest keeps it friendly, while A's red-tipped frills and slumped faint-end pose sink it.

top_changes.change: Repaint creature skins to the creature colour board's clean colour blocking: remove the black/yellow/lime camouflage blotches (Eg, Ln back plates), give each creature a lighter face mask with clear eyes, and add a rim light so dark bodies (Cb A, Vv, Ln) lift off the ground. Also move all red crest and frill tips to cream, peach or teal.
Rebuild the homestead wall as a thick timber-and-stone piece: plank or wattle infill with real texture and value, a visible top cap or beam, and a darker stone footing set into the ground.

Fix scale and pose grounding: scale low creatures (Cb, Eg) so they stand clearly taller than the 1.80 m trainer, keep faint poses on the ground (Uv B flips and floats), and show the rider in ridden frames.
